github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use Conventional Commits such as feat:, fix:, refactor:, test:, docs:, or chore:. Keep the first line under 72 characters and describe the purpose of the change rather than listing every modified file.

github.copilot.chat.reviewSelection.inst.text: When reviewing code, highlight any potential issues or improvements, and suggest best practices. Focus on the overall functionality and maintainability of the code rather than minor stylistic details.
